labels.label: contradicts
labels.note: The request for an adjournment suggests undue delay in the proceedings.
labels.observation: O1 (2025-06-02): Ms. Brask told the court that she had received the 900-page case file only three days before this hearing and asked for an adjournment of two weeks to prepare the defence.

labels.label: contradicts
labels.note: The refusal to adjourn the trial indicates a lack of undue delay.
labels.observation: O2 (2025-06-02): The presiding judge refused the request and ordered the trial to continue.

labels.observation: O3 (2025-06-02): The presiding judge informed Mr. Venn that he had the right to remain silent.
